message:
There's a build directory. Let me check if the fuzzer binary is built and test my PoC locally:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul -name "config_fuzzer" -type f 2>/dev/null; find /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul -name "*.a" -o -name "*.so" 2>/dev/null | head</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
